schema.text: Who might find it hard or impossible to use this place?

options.text: People using a walker or walking aid
Children (for example walking alone to school)
People who walk slowly or need more time (for example older people)
People who find it hard to find their way or understand signs

en.#People using a walker or walking aid: People using a walker or walking aid
en.#Children (for example walking alone to: Children (for example walking alone to school)

it.#Who might find it hard or impossible to: Per chi potrebbe essere difficile o impossibile usare questo luogo?
it.#People using wheelchairs: Persone che usano una sedia a rotelle
it.#People using a walker or walking aid: Persone con deambulatore o ausili per camminare
it.#Children (for example walking alone to: Bambini (per esempio che vanno a scuola da soli)
it.#People who walk slowly or need more tim: Persone che camminano lentamente o hanno bisogno di più tempo (per esempio persone anziane)
it.#People who find it hard to find their w: Persone che hanno difficoltà a orientarsi o a capire i segnali

fr.#Who might find it hard or impossible to: Pour qui l'utilisation de ce lieu pourrait-elle être difficile ou impossible ?
fr.#People using a walker or walking aid: Personnes utilisant un déambulateur ou une aide à la marche
fr.#Children (for example walking alone to: Enfants (par exemple qui vont seuls à l'école)
fr.#People who walk slowly or need more tim: Personnes qui marchent lentement ou ont besoin de plus de temps (par exemple les personnes âgées)
fr.#People who find it hard to find their w: Personnes qui ont du mal à s'orienter ou à comprendre les panneaux

de.#Who might find it hard or impossible to: Für wen könnte es schwierig oder unmöglich sein, diesen Ort zu nutzen?
de.#Children (for example walking alone to: Kinder (zum Beispiel, die allein zur Schule gehen)
de.#People who walk slowly or need more tim: Menschen, die langsam gehen oder mehr Zeit brauchen (zum Beispiel ältere Menschen)
de.#People who find it hard to find their w: Menschen, denen die Orientierung oder das Verstehen von Schildern schwerfällt

tr.#Who might find it hard or impossible to: Bu yeri kullanmak kimler için zor veya imkânsız olabilir?
tr.#People using a walker or walking aid: Yürüteç veya yürüme desteği kullanan kişiler
tr.#People who walk slowly or need more tim: Yavaş yürüyen veya daha fazla zamana ihtiyaç duyan kişiler (örneğin yaşlılar)
tr.#People who find it hard to find their w: Yolunu bulmakta veya işaretleri anlamakta zorlanan kişiler

fa.#Who might find it hard or impossible to: استفاده از این مکان برای چه کسانی ممکن است دشوار یا ناممکن باشد؟
fa.#People using a walker or walking aid: افراد استفاده‌کننده از واکر یا وسیله کمک‌راه‌رفتن
fa.#Children (for example walking alone to: کودکان (برای مثال کودکانی که تنها به مدرسه می‌روند)
fa.#People who walk slowly or need more tim: افرادی که آهسته راه می‌روند یا به زمان بیشتری نیاز دارند (برای مثال سالمندان)
fa.#People who find it hard to find their w: افرادی که در جهت‌یابی یا فهم تابلوها مشکل دارند

hu.#Who might find it hard or impossible to: Kinek lehet nehéz vagy lehetetlen használni ezt a helyet?
hu.#People using a walker or walking aid: Járókeretet vagy járást segítő eszközt használók
hu.#People who walk slowly or need more tim: Lassan járó vagy több időt igénylő emberek (például idősek)
hu.#People who find it hard to find their w: Akiknek nehéz tájékozódni vagy megérteni a jelzéseket

ar.#Who might find it hard or impossible to: لمن قد يكون استخدام هذا المكان صعبًا أو مستحيلًا؟
ar.#People using a walker or walking aid: مستخدمو المشاية أو وسائل المساعدة على المشي
ar.#Children (for example walking alone to: الأطفال (مثلًا من يذهبون إلى المدرسة بمفردهم)
ar.#People who walk slowly or need more tim: الأشخاص الذين يمشون ببطء أو يحتاجون إلى وقت أطول (مثل كبار السن)
ar.#People who find it hard to find their w: الأشخاص الذين يجدون صعوبة في تحديد الاتجاه أو فهم الإشارات
